answer: Random peer audit bond: each identity claims one mesa plot, locks 80 and files a shale core log each epoch. A random peer re-measures that core; logs must agree within 2% or both bonds burn. An oasis station posts both logs. Each fake needs a new mesa plot, shale sample, and auditor: 45+12(k-1); 1,000 cost 6,039,000. Rented auditors fail: paired logs are public; a mismatch burns both. An honest agent pays 45 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
